title: Money Merch: Instantly Outbound to Businesses That Buy Uniforms

client.industry: custom apparel: screen printing, embroidery and branded merchandise

how_it_works: One list per industry you give, only companies that buy uniforms or branded workwear
The person who orders the apparel, verified email, current customers removed
Instantly campaigns on separate domains, one mailbox per 175 companies a month
Positive replies to your sales team, weekly report on your measures
setup: Lookalike sending domains and mailboxes, your main domain never sends cold
Mailboxes warmed before the first send
One Instantly campaign and 3-email sequence per industry
need_from_you: Your industries and criteria, in the order you want them
Your current customer list to keep off every campaign
Who on your sales team takes positive replies, and where

sections.label: 1 - RESEARCH AND LISTS
sections.note: Your parts 1 to 3, one list per industry you give: construction, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, automotive, property management, restaurants and hospitality, gyms and fitness, warehouses and logistics, home services, multi-location businesses and companies with large employee teams. A company that doesn't buy uniforms or branded workwear never gets an email. Apollo, Sales Navigator, Clay or ZoomInfo: whichever you already pay for.

sections.label: 2 - VERIFY AND CLEAN
sections.note: Your parts 4 and 5. Every address is verified before it reaches Instantly, and anyone already buying from you comes off the list.

sections.label: 3 - INSTANTLY CAMPAIGNS AND DELIVERABILITY
sections.note: Your parts 6 to 9. Cold email never sends from your main domain, and your monthly company target sets how many mailboxes.

sections.label: 4 - A/B TESTS AND POSITIVE-REPLY HANDOFF
sections.note: Your parts 10 to 12. One change tested at a time, bad data removed as it shows up, and only positive replies go to your sales team.

sections.label: 5 - REPORTING
sections.note: Your part 13, scored on your measures: list quality, valid email and bounce rate, positive reply rate, qualified leads, meetings or quote opportunities, and improvement over time.

nodes.label: 1 - Research Each Industry You Give: Google Maps, Apollo, Sales Navigator
2 - Buys Uniforms or Branded Workwear?
nodes.notes: Their line: not someone who simply sends thousands of emails.

nodes.label: 3 - Find Who Orders the Uniforms: Owner, Operations or Office Manager

5 - Clean the List: Remove Duplicates, Risky Emails and Current Customers
6 - Into Instantly: One Campaign Per Industry, 3 Emails With Follow-Ups

nodes.notes: Your main domain never carries cold sends.

nodes.label: 8 - Watch Deliverability, Bounce and Reply Rates Every Day
9 - A/B Test Subject Lines, Messaging, Offers and Sequences
10 - Remove Bad Data: Bounces, Wrong Contacts, Closed Businesses
12 - Hand It to Your Sales Team: Contact, Company, Uniform Need
nodes.notes: Qualified opportunities only, with the reply attached.

nodes.label: 13 - Weekly Report: Volume, Replies, Interested Leads, Meetings, Quotes
nodes.notes: Your six success measures, per campaign and per industry.

input_sample.uniform_signal: techs in matching logo shirts on Google Maps photos, 9 service vans

output_sample.reply: We're hiring four techs this spring. Can you quote embroidered shirts and jackets with our logo?
